scheme_name: Scheme of Grant-In-Aid for Conduct of Art Exhibitions: Group Shows
other_conditions: The applicant must be a group of artists, specifically a group of five artists.
Artists must be natives of Tamil Nadu with continuous residence for at least 5 years.
Artists must have continuous involvement in painting and sculpture.
Artists should possess an adequate number of artworks for conducting the show.
Participation in National or State level Art Exhibitions and Artists Camps is considered an additional qualification.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per group of artists.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attestation if required)
